note: Straight-alpha RGBA layers, far to near. Each PNG includes the overscan margin; place its top-left at `offset` in painting coordinates. depth: suggested parallax factor (0 = sky ... 1 = nearest). flat.png = all layers composited with normal blending.

layers.name: sky
layers.note: dawn sky through the canopy gap; opaque

layers.name: far
layers.note: far crowns around the gap, pale far trunks, far understorey in mist

layers.name: mist_far
layers.note: mist between far and mid trees; glow behind the robot

layers.name: mid
layers.note: mid trunks + crowns rimming the gap, perch branches, clearing floor (robot kneels on it)

layers.name: mist_mid
layers.note: warm glowing mist behind the robot; the robot goes above this layer

layers.name: beams
layers.note: sunbeams through the gap (could be animated: opacity shimmer)

layers.name: near
layers.note: giant framing trunks (camphor left, beech right), roots, near crowns at the top

layers.name: fg
layers.note: foreground: overhanging leaves at the top, vines, ferns in the bottom corners

camera: tilt down from frames.start to frames.end; anchor parallax at the end frame
